column1: # Every `pro` command path the CLI shipped before spec-derived naming, with the
# shape it had then and the shape it has now. See invocation_sweep_test.go.
#   leaf  — resolves to a command that runs and returns a result
#   group — resolves to a parent, which prints help and exits 0
#   gone  — no longer resolves at all (`now` only)
# A `leaf`->`group` row is the worst shape a rename can take and there are three:
# the path still resolves and still exits 0, and a script piping it into jq gets
# help text instead of data. Recorded here and in CHANGELOG.md's migration table.
